mode.info: Separate from the app updater. Mumcord looks for plugin updates when it starts and every 6 hours while it runs.

empty: All plugins are up to date.
emptyOff: Plugin updates are off. Turn them on above to look for updates.
needsPermissions: This version needs more permissions. Review them before you update.
newAuthorKey: This version is signed by a different author. Only update if you trust the new author.
rolledBack: Version {{version}} could not start, so the previous version was restored. Reason:
installFailed: {{name}} could not be updated. Please try again.
pinsHint: A pinned plugin stays on its current version and is not offered updates.
